Hi Elena / Vendr team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to stage the Clearstream bundle for upload but want to lock a short, guarded window where your ingest will accept the bulk and we can confirm provenance and metadata mapping. Key asks below: 

- Proposed window: Thu 10 Dec 2026, 09:00–11:00 PT (we can shift earlier/later by 2 hours if that helps).
- We'll upload an initial manifest (attached) with the CAIQ/SIG mapping column filled; please confirm the mapping for the following fields: evidence_type, control_id, S3_object_url.
- We plan a two-step verification: (1) upload + immediate API validation, (2) manual spot-check of 10 random items in your portal.
- Please confirm whether OneTrust export sync will pick up Vendr's record ids (we want stable ids for our SOC 2 audit).

Attachments: evidence_manifest_v2.csv, SIG-mapping-template.xlsx, upload-window-calendar.ics

If the window works, I'll circulate a minimal runbook and assign upload owners on our side.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi — that window looks good from our side. Quick clarifications: 

1) Ingest SLA: We will accept the bulk during the 09:00–11:00 PT window and run an automatic validation. Any files that fail schema validation will be flagged and held in a quarantine queue — we'll provide a failure report within 20 minutes of upload completion.

2) ID propagation: Vendr will emit stable portal_record_id values; OneTrust export should be able to include those if you enable the "portal_id" mapping in the OneTrust connector (we'll confirm exact field name).

3) Spot-check: Elena or Tom can join the spot-check; please include the row numbers for the 10 samples so we can pull the same objects.

4) Rate limits: For bulk S3 ingest we allow up to 200 concurrent objects per minute for accounts on the onboarding tier — if you expect larger bursts, we can temporarily bump to 500/minute for the two-hour window. Tell us approximate object count and average file size.

We'll also post a quick runbook to the portal link you supplied and confirm the API key scope once you create the upload token.

Best,
Elena
Onboarding Lead — Vendr
